subject: Resourcing — romanized LID
body: Dmitri — resourcing picture. Current window: Rafael 50% (modeling), Leilani 40% (data conversion across the three resources), Milan 40% (router integration spike), Carmen 20% (eval design). Looking past the June decision point: the Aksharantar-driven expansion to the full 20+ language set is the obvious H2 continuation, and Rafael Duran is committed at 60% to this project for July 2026 — I've locked that in the allocation sheet so we don't lose him to whatever fire flares up next quarter. Compute is light (CPU plus a handful of titan-a100 GPUs for the transformer baselines). One dependency: keep the Corpus v2 migration freeze date (2026-07-10) on our radar — if the router integration slips past June it collides with the freeze window. — Alina
